title: Encrypted DNS Discovery RFC 9463 DHCPv6 OPTION_V6_DNR Wire Work Item
summary: Add trace-owned byte-level support for RFC 9463 DHCPv6 OPTION_V6_DNR.
planned_changes:
- Add `EncryptedDnsDiscoveryDhcpv6Option` for OPTION_V6_DNR TLV encode/decode.
- Encode and decode RFC 8415 authentication-domain-name wire format.
- Encode and validate IPv6 Addr Length and IPv6 resolver address lists.
- Reuse RFC 9460 SvcParam key/value encoding and reject superseded address hints.
- Support ADN-only mode and OPTION_ORO request data.
- Decode multiple OPTION_V6_DNR instances as separate resolvers sorted by service priority.
- Silently discard invalid OPTION_V6_DNR values when using the batch decoder.
- Add focused positive and negative tests plus canonical xrefs.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused DHCPv6 option tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full solution test before commit.
out_of_scope: Neighbor Discovery encrypted DNS option encoding and padding.
Full DHCP client state and platform resolver configuration.
PKIX certificate validation and resolver connection establishment.
completion_notes: The DNS adapter now has a trace-owned DHCPv6 OPTION_V6_DNR wire floor that can feed future DHCP client, ProtocolLab, or resolver-selection integration.
